name: Carlos Taboada Law Firm CRM
summary: A private legal CRM that organizes appointments, intake notes, client information, case evaluation, and follow-up for attorneys and secretaries.
functions: Registers cases at reception, schedules appointments, stores notes, supports attorney review, and tracks accepted matters through client contact and follow-up.
problem: The firm needed a secure workflow for receiving legal inquiries, evaluating requirements, assigning cases, and protecting sensitive client information.
solution: I built a role-based system where secretaries register inquiries and attorneys evaluate immigration, criminal, and other cases before acceptance and follow-up.

demo.title: Private legal system
demo.description: Public access is prohibited because the platform contains confidential case and client data protected by privacy, professional secrecy, and legal requirements.
